title: Higher graded algebra sheaf and normalized graded extensions
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $X$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and $\rho:A\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ a ring map. For $a\geq1$ put $J=I\mathcal O_X$ and $X^{[a]}=V(J^a)$ with its canonical closed subscheme structure. Define $G_a(X)=\bigoplus_{q\in\mathbf Z}J^q/J^{q+a}$ on $X^{[a]}$, where $J^q=\mathcal O_X$ for $q\leq0$, with multiplication on ideal representatives. Explicitly, on an ambient open $U$ form the extended Rees algebra $\mathcal O_X(U)[t,J_Ut^{-1}]$ with $J_U$ generated by $\rho(I)$ restricted to $U$, quotient by $(t^a)$, sheafify [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], and take inverse image along $X^{[a]}\to X$; Laurent exponent $-q$ has degree $q$. Restrictions are the coefficient maps, which preserve $(t^a)$ and satisfy the identity and composition laws. There is a unique degree-zero structural map $\mathcal O_{X^{[a]}}\to G_a(X)$ sending ambient constants to their Rees quotient classes. The base ring $G_a(A)$ is the same Rees quotient for $(A,I)$. For another such scheme $(Y,\sigma)$ and an isomorphism $\phi:X^{[a]}\to Y^{[a]}$, an extension is an isomorphism $G_a(Y)\to\phi_*G_a(X)$ whose stalk maps carry each degree onto the same degree, preserve the canonical classes of every element of $G_a(A)$, and agree on the degree-zero structure sheaf with the map induced by $\phi$. Equivalently it is a graded $G_a(A)$-algebra isomorphism $\phi^{-1}G_a(Y)\to G_a(X)$ inducing $\phi$ in degree zero.
